rationale: The agent executed multiple order-changing writes (address modification for #W5056519, item exchange on #W5056519, and cancellation of #W5995614) without first confirming each action with the user, violating the stated policy. Authentication was limited to looking up a user by email supplied in the request, with no clear verification step. There’s no explicit verification that the orders belonged to the user before acting. The final response did not provide clear confirmation of what changes were made or any resulting details (e.g., address used, exchange item specifics, pricing or payment implications, or cancellation confirmation). These issues fail the pass bar requiring authentication, confirmation before writes, correct execution, and accurate final information.
